title: FeedbackRecord
description: Immutable Orchestrator audit record for a round evaluated by the deterministic Judge. Embeds the canonical Judge result unchanged, with its decision, pinned versions, and stable references to the exact artifacts used. It records feedback; it does not itself update prompts, criteria, or detections.

task_id.description: Task identifier from round_request. It is also the round id.

round_id.description: Orchestrator round identifier; must equal task_id.

decision.description: Exact copy of judge_result.decision, including status, reasons, failed gates, and machine-readable failures.

artifact_refs.description: Stable references to the exact persisted contract documents used in this round. References are opaque to consumers; resolve them through the owning artifact store.

versions.description: Pinned reproducibility versions copied from the frozen round configuration, including contract, prompts, model, rule, dataset/evaluation set, and criteria versions.

judge_result.description: Complete canonical Judge result, embedded unchanged for audit and convenience. The artifact reference points to its persisted source document.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp at which the feedback record was assembled.

artifact_ref.description: Immutable datastore/evidence-store reference returned when the artifact was persisted (for example, a URI or opaque database identifier).
